args.code:
from collections import deque

N = 200
S_min = set()
queue = deque([0])
S_min.add(0)

while queue:
    n = queue.popleft()

    # Operation +11
    n1 = n + 11
    if n1 <= N and n1 not in S_min:
        S_min.add(n1)
        queue.append(n1)

    # Operation +20
    n2 = n + 20
    if n2 <= N and n2 not in S_min:
        S_min.add(n2)
        queue.append(n2)

# Check for gaps in the range [0, N]
has_gaps = False
for i in range(N + 1):
    if i not in S_min:
        has_gaps = True
        break

# Output results
print(f"Size of S_min up to {N}: {len(S_min)}")
print("Elements in S_min (sorted):")
print(sorted(list(S_min)))
print(f"Are there gaps in [0, {N}]? {has_gaps}")
